title: 英法海底隧道~Channel Tunnel
focus: 主孔服務孔介面、壓力波與長期可維護性~Running-bore and service-gallery interfaces, pressure waves and maintainability
summary: 英法海底隧道讓客貨列車與車輛接駁列車通過英吉利海峽，營運商列長約50公里並記錄1994年啟用。本進階課把海底水壓、襯砌接縫、熱量、氣動擾動與維修可用率連成同一系統，特別比較主孔與服務通道的任務差異，避免把各設備單獨合格當整體服務可靠。~The approximately 50 km Channel Tunnel carries passenger, freight and vehicle-shuttle trains beneath the English Channel and opened in 1994. This advanced course links subsea pressure, lining joints, heat, aerodynamic disturbances and maintenance availability. It distinguishes the duties of running bores and service access, showing why individual equipment compliance does not by itself establish a reliable operating system.

units.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓~Piezometric head and lining pressure
units.mechanism: 英法海底案例先區分海面水深與岩層測壓水頭，避免把海床幾何直接當襯砌各處水壓；服務通道排水也會影響局部梯度。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。~Distinguish seawater depth from rock piezometric head, including local gradients affected by service-gallery drainage rather than equating seabed geometry with pressure everywhere. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=34 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=333.54 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為366.894 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=34 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=333.54 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 366.894 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將主孔與服務孔測壓點用同一高程和潮位基準比較，檢查水頭相位差是否支持連通假設。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare bore and service-gallery piezometers on one elevation and tide datum, testing whether phase differences support hydraulic connectivity. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 潮汐反應滯後若當成儀器故障，會錯過含水層傳遞時間與排水邊界變化。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。~Mistaking tidal lag for sensor failure loses information about aquifer response time and drainage-boundary changes. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.
units.misconception: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。~No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
units.practice: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：將主孔與服務孔測壓點用同一高程和潮位基準比較，檢查水頭相位差是否支持連通假設。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。~For Channel Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare bore and service-gallery piezometers on one elevation and tide datum, testing whether phase differences support hydraulic connectivity. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

units.anchor: 襯砌環向壓縮~Lining hoop compression
units.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度~Ring force and joint flexibility
units.mechanism: 比較英法主孔及服務通道的襯砌尺度，幾何縮小雖改變膜應力量級，接頭轉角、局部荷載及維修開口仍須獨立評估。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。~Compare lining scales in running bores and service access; geometric scaling changes membrane stress but does not preserve joint rotations, local loads or maintenance-opening behaviour. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.32 MPa；半徑=3.1 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=2.83429 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為3.11771 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.32 MPa; radius=3.1 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=2.83429 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 3.11771 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 分別建立兩種斷面的接頭模型，將同水頭下環向變形與開口附近局部應變對照。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Model both jointed sections separately and compare circumferential movement with local strains near openings under matched head. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把小孔的接縫性能按比例套到大孔，可能忽略更大的絕對張開和局部偏心。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。~Scaling small-bore sealing performance to the larger bore can miss increased absolute opening and local eccentricity. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening.
units.misconception: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。~Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
units.practice: 本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：分別建立兩種斷面的接頭模型，將同水頭下環向變形與開口附近局部應變對照。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。~For Channel Tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Model both jointed sections separately and compare circumferential movement with local strains near openings under matched head. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.

units.anchor: 止水壓縮餘量~Gasket compression reserve
units.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡~Joint compression and sealing envelope
units.mechanism: 服務通道與主孔間的連接令止水介面不只沿圓環分布，教學比較規則接縫和分岔部位的變形相容，不能只按平均寬度分類。止水條依受控壓縮維持連續接觸，接縫轉角、錯台、污染與材料鬆弛都會降低最不利點的接觸能力。平均壓縮量不能掩蓋局部脫離；全尺寸試驗的結果只對測試過的幾何、水壓及荷載歷程有效，幾何餘量本身並不是接觸壓力。~Connections between service access and running bores create nonuniform interfaces; compare regular joints with branch movement compatibility rather than classifying seals by mean gap alone. A gasket seals through controlled continuous compression; rotation, offset, contamination and relaxation reduce contact at the weakest point. Average compression cannot compensate for local separation. Full-size test results apply only to their tested geometry, head and load history, while a calculated geometric reserve is neither contact pressure nor evidence of watertightness.
units.model: 原創教學假設：初始壓縮=19 mm；張開量=3.4 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=13.6 mm。僅把張開量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為13.26 mm。邊界：單向幾何餘量，不是接觸壓或水密合格證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=19 mm; opening=3.4 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=13.6 mm. Increasing only opening by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 13.26 mm. Boundary: One-direction geometric reserve, not contact pressure or proof of watertightness. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 在接縫轉角及分岔附近保存錯台方向，選全尺寸測試中真正對應的組合，而非只比水壓。全尺寸接頭試驗分別改變張開、錯台與外水壓，記錄漏水起點與卸載後殘餘位移，對照材料批次及溫度。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Retain offset direction at rotated and branched interfaces and select the matching full-size test combination, not pressure alone. Vary opening, offset and pressure in full-size joint tests, recording leakage onset and residual movement against material batch and temperature. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 不同方向錯台可能讓密封接觸區遷移，單一正向試驗合格不能證明反向循環後仍水密。扭曲或沾污的止水條可形成旁通通道，即使平均縫寬合格仍可能漏水；盲目灌漿也可能只轉移出水位置。~Opposite offsets can shift the sealing contact zone; passing one-direction tests does not prove tightness after reversed cycles. A twisted or contaminated gasket creates bypass leakage despite acceptable mean width; indiscriminate grouting may merely move the outlet.
units.misconception: 接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。~An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
units.practice: 本案「止水壓縮餘量」的交付需回答：在接縫轉角及分岔附近保存錯台方向，選全尺寸測試中真正對應的組合，而非只比水壓。保存接縫幾何與試驗壓力的配對紀錄，由設計者核定允收包絡；驗收時不能把課堂的幾何餘量當產品認證數字。~For Channel Tunnel, the gasket compression reserve handover must address the following evidence: Retain offset direction at rotated and branched interfaces and select the matching full-size test combination, not pressure alone. Retain paired joint geometry and test pressure, with the designer approving the acceptance envelope; classroom geometric reserves are not product certification values.

units.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸~Shared access and transport bottlenecks
units.mechanism: 長海底隧道的維修物流需在列車服務與服務通道使用間協調，備料的距離和返回時間會影響實際工作窗口，不只看工具進入時間。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。~Maintenance logistics must fit railway service and service-access use; material distance and return time constrain the window beyond the time needed to bring tools inside. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
units.model: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=21 t；往返週期=33 min。C=N payload 60/T=152.727 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為138.843 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=21 t; cycle=33 min. C=N payload 60/T=152.727 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 138.843 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 用工單時間戳分開進入、作業、清點及撤出，核對共用路線是否在同一窗口被另一任務占用。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Separate access, work, inventory checks and withdrawal in work-order timestamps and identify overlapping use of shared routes. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只安排作業時間而不留撤出驗證，會把未清空的工作面錯報成可恢復列車服務。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。~Scheduling work without verified withdrawal time can incorrectly report an occupied worksite as ready for railway service. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.
units.misconception: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。~Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
units.practice: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：用工單時間戳分開進入、作業、清點及撤出，核對共用路線是否在同一窗口被另一任務占用。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。~For Channel Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Separate access, work, inventory checks and withdrawal in work-order timestamps and identify overlapping use of shared routes. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

units.title: 熱源分配與空氣顯熱~Heat sources and sensible-air removal
units.mechanism: 英法列車與設備熱源會隨服務密度改變，分析正常高峰和一條冷卻路徑維修時的空氣及水側熱帳，避免把裝置容量直接視為可移除熱量。深部岩體、列車和機械會向空氣持續放熱，空氣帶走的顯熱由質量流量與溫升決定。相同體積風量在不同密度下不具有相同散熱能力；濕度、岩體瞬變及水冷系統還需分開記帳，單一穩態熱平衡不能預測全部溫度尖峰。~Traffic-dependent heat must be reconciled across air and water during peaks and cooling-path maintenance rather than equating installed capacity with removable heat. Deep rock, trains and machinery release heat to the air, whose sensible removal depends on mass flow and temperature rise. Equal volumetric flow at different density does not provide equal cooling. Moisture, transient rock heat and water cooling need separate accounts; a steady balance cannot predict every temperature peak or local worker exposure.
units.model: 原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；體積風量=82 m³/s；定壓比熱=1.005 kJ/(kg·K)；溫升=12 K。Q=ρVcpΔT=1186.7 kW。僅把體積風量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1305.37 kW。邊界：僅空氣顯熱，不含濕度潛熱及岩體瞬變；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; volume flow=82 m³/s; specific heat=1.005 kJ/(kg·K); temperature rise=12 K. Q=ρVcpΔT=1186.7 kW. Increasing only volume flow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1305.37 kW. Boundary: Sensible air heat only, excluding latent heat and rock transients. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 配對列車通過時段、設備功率、進出口溫差和流量，檢查熱量殘差是否集中在服務高峰。同步量測進出口溫濕度、風量及設備負載，分開平均與尖峰時段，用能量收支殘差檢查漏列熱源。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Pair train passages, equipment power, temperature rise and flow, checking whether energy residuals cluster during peak service. Synchronise inlet/outlet temperature, humidity, flow and equipment load, separate average and peak periods, and use energy residuals to identify missing sources. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 平均日溫度正常可能遮住列車連續通過的局部熱峰，需保留時間解析度再判斷冷卻不足。把低密度空氣視為海平面空氣會高估散熱，局部熱點也可能被斷面平均溫度掩蓋，導致設備或工作環境超限。~A normal daily mean can conceal local peaks during successive train passages; retain time resolution before judging cooling adequacy. Assuming sea-level density overstates cooling at low density, while cross-sectional averages hide hot spots affecting equipment and the work environment.
units.misconception: 只要體積風量相同，不同海拔的空氣散熱量一定相同。~Equal volumetric airflow provides identical cooling at every altitude.
units.practice: 本案「通風顯熱量」的交付需回答：配對列車通過時段、設備功率、進出口溫差和流量，檢查熱量殘差是否集中在服務高峰。熱帳分別列岩體、交通、機械與水冷路徑，交接時保存季節和負載範圍，設備增設前須重新核對可用散熱能力。~For Channel Tunnel, the ventilation sensible heat handover must address the following evidence: Pair train passages, equipment power, temperature rise and flow, checking whether energy residuals cluster during peak service. Keep rock, traffic, machinery and water-cooling paths separate; retain seasonal and load ranges and reassess cooling capacity before adding equipment.

units.anchor: 入口壓力擾動~Portal pressure disturbance
units.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級~Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale
units.mechanism: 英法主孔的列車種類與速度不同，阻塞比和交會情境應分案；服務通道門位又會改變壓力反射邊界，不能用單一動壓替代波動歷程。列車進洞壓縮前方空氣，波動在洞口、橫通道和斷面變化處傳播與反射。速度和阻塞比影響壓力量級，但不可壓動壓只是比較尺度，不能替代可壓縮瞬變計算；兩車交會、門位與列車外形都可能改變乘客及設備的壓力歷程。~Different train types, speeds and encounter cases change blockage and wave behaviour; service-access door states also alter reflections beyond a single dynamic-pressure estimate. A train entering a tunnel compresses the air ahead, producing waves reflected at portals, passages and section changes. Speed and blockage influence magnitude, but incompressible dynamic pressure is only a comparison scale, not a compressible transient solution. Train encounters, door states and vehicle shape change the pressure histories experienced by passengers and equipment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=41 m/s。q=ρv²/2=1008.6 Pa。僅把列車速度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1220.41 Pa。邊界：不可壓動壓尺度，不是可壓縮列車壓力波解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=41 m/s. q=ρv²/2=1008.6 Pa. Increasing only train speed by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1220.41 Pa. Boundary: Incompressible dynamic-pressure scale, not a compressible train pressure-wave solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 在列車通過前後同步量測門兩側壓力，將列車編組與門位一起保存，檢查反射峰抵達時間。以相同列車編組、速度和門位量測多點壓力歷程，檢查峰值、上升時間及反射抵達時刻，而不只比較一個最大值。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Synchronise pressure across doors before and after passage, retaining formation and door state to check reflected-wave arrival. Measure pressure histories at several points with matching train formation, speed and door states, comparing rise time and reflection arrival as well as peaks. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只存最大壓力不存升壓時間，可能漏掉設備密封與乘客感受所受的快速變化。以單一動壓數字當允收值會漏掉壓力梯度與反射疊加，可能使門扇、密封或乘客舒適度需求被低估。~Saving only peak pressure loses rapid changes relevant to seals and passenger comfort. Using one dynamic-pressure value for acceptance misses gradients and superposed reflections, understating demands on doors, seals or passenger comfort.
units.misconception: 動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。~A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「入口壓力擾動」的交付需回答：在列車通過前後同步量測門兩側壓力，將列車編組與門位一起保存，檢查反射峰抵達時間。試車報告記錄編組、速度、溫度及門位版本，土建斷面變更與設備耐壓驗證共用同一氣動模型，不能各自選有利情境。~For Channel Tunnel, the portal pressure disturbance handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise pressure across doors before and after passage, retaining formation and door state to check reflected-wave arrival. Trial reports retain formation, speed, temperature and door revisions; civil changes and equipment-pressure checks share one aerodynamic model rather than selectively favourable cases.

units.anchor: 所需疏散時間~Required evacuation time
units.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性~Evacuation time and zone availability
units.mechanism: 英法服務通道提供不同於運行孔的接收空間，疏散模型需確認到達之後的人流容量與可用狀態，不能在越過第一道門時就結束計時。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。~Service access provides a receiving space distinct from the running bore; evacuation modelling must include capacity and availability after the first doorway, not stop its clock there. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
units.model: 原創教學假設：前置時間=82 s；行走距離=320 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=482 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為522 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=82 s; travel distance=320 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=482 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 522 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 演練或模擬分開通過橫通道門與後續移動時間，核對接收區人數及通訊延遲。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Separate doorway crossing from onward movement in drills or models, checking receiving-zone occupancy and communication delays. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 通道本身可用但接收區壅塞時，隊列會回堵主孔，使用單一平均步速會低估所需時間。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。~Congestion in an otherwise accessible receiving zone can queue people back into the running bore and defeat an average-speed estimate. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.
units.misconception: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。~Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
units.practice: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：演練或模擬分開通過橫通道門與後續移動時間，核對接收區人數及通訊延遲。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。~For Channel Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Separate doorway crossing from onward movement in drills or models, checking receiving-zone occupancy and communication delays. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

units.anchor: 剩餘集水容積~Remaining sump volume
units.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積~Outage buffer and effective sump volume
units.mechanism: 海底排水的可靠性需連結低點集水、供電與維修隔離，假想兩台泵中一台退出時，分析淨入流與警報延遲而不把原容量沿用。集水坑在泵停止後提供有限緩衝，剩餘容積需扣除初始水量、沉積及不可用死角。緩衝時間取決於淨入流，不是名牌抽水能力；警報延遲、備援切換與水量突增會消耗餘裕，排水電力又可能與其他安全設備共用失效原因。~Link low-point sumps, power and maintenance isolation; when one hypothetical pump is unavailable, recalculate net inflow and alarm delay rather than retaining the original capacity. A sump offers finite buffering after pumps stop, with usable volume reduced by initial water, sediment and dead spaces. Buffer time depends on net inflow rather than pump nameplate capacity. Alarm delay, transfer time and inflow surges consume reserve, while shared electrical dependencies may disable drainage and other safety equipment together.
units.model: 原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=320 m³；淨入流=0.19 m³/s。t=V/Q/60=28.0702 min。僅把淨入流增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為25.5183 min。邊界：停泵固定入流，不含警報延遲及水量突增；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=320 m³; net inflow=0.19 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=28.0702 min. Increasing only net inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 25.5183 min. Boundary: Constant inflow during outage, excluding alarm delay and inflow surges. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將水位上升曲線與當時泵啟停、閥位及出水流量同步，區分閥路阻塞和機械輸出不足。以水位容積曲線和流量計核對停泵水位上升率，另檢查淤積、警報時間戳及備援電力切換紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Synchronise level rise with pump state, valves and discharge, distinguishing blocked routing from deficient mechanical output. Compare outage level-rise rate with the level-volume curve and flowmeter, separately checking sediment, alarm timestamps and backup-power transfer records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 名義備泵若共用堵塞出口，切換成功但水位仍升；應查管路而非反覆切換泵。未扣除沉積的總容積會高估反應時間，若警報與抽水同失電，操作者可能在緩衝已耗盡後才得知水位上升。~A spare sharing a blocked outlet can transfer successfully while water keeps rising; diagnose the route instead of repeatedly switching pumps. Gross volume without sediment deduction overstates response time; shared loss of alarm and pumping power can hide rising water until the buffer is exhausted.
units.misconception: 集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。~Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
units.practice: 本案「剩餘集水容積」的交付需回答：將水位上升曲線與當時泵啟停、閥位及出水流量同步，區分閥路阻塞和機械輸出不足。交接有效容積、初始水位及延遲預算，由排水與電氣責任人共同核對故障情境，定期清淤後保存量測證據。~For Channel Tunnel, the remaining sump volume handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise level rise with pump state, valves and discharge, distinguishing blocked routing from deficient mechanical output. Handover usable volume, initial level and delay budgets; drainage and electrical owners jointly review failures and retain measurements after sediment removal.

units.title: 設備備援與共同失效~Equipment redundancy and common failure
units.mechanism: 英法跨境服務把電力、控制、冷卻與維修責任放在多個介面，設備重複不能消除共用軟體或配電故障，需以功能可用性定義頂事件。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。~Cross-border service couples power, controls, cooling and maintenance responsibilities; duplicated equipment does not eliminate shared software or distribution faults, so define top events by lost function. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works. Shared power, software, cooling or flood exposure breaks that assumption. Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities.
units.model: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.011 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.000121 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00014641 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.011 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.000121 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00014641 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 從一項失去服務的事件反向追到共用電源和控制版本，再比對維修時設備是否真的獨立。由設備清單畫出故障樹，將電源、控制及實體位置追到共同節點，並用事件及維修紀錄檢查獨立假設。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Trace one loss-of-service event back to common supply and control revisions and test independence during maintenance. Build a fault tree from the asset list, trace power, control and location to shared nodes, and test independence against incident and maintenance records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把同一次共同電源故障拆成兩個獨立事件會嚴重低估並聯不可用率，且掩蓋責任介面。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。~Splitting one common-supply fault into independent events understates parallel unavailability and hides interface responsibility. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability.
units.misconception: 設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。~Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
units.practice: 本案「系統不可用率」的交付需回答：從一項失去服務的事件反向追到共用電源和控制版本，再比對維修時設備是否真的獨立。維修計畫附當日可用配置與剩餘備援，任何共同資源更動同步更新故障樹，切換試驗由設備及營運團隊共同見證。~For Channel Tunnel, the system unavailability handover must address the following evidence: Trace one loss-of-service event back to common supply and control revisions and test independence during maintenance. Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 英法長期營運需要把更新設備與原設施共同管理，資料交接必須保留新舊版本適用里程及日期，不能讓歷史趨勢因供應商更換而中斷。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Long-term renewal requires old and new systems to coexist in records, with chainage and dates defining each revision rather than losing historical trends when suppliers change. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=101 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.1584 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為82.5743 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=101 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.1584 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 82.5743 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 抽查更換過的感測器，從現行標籤追到舊型號校正與工單，驗證量程和零點是否可比。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Sample a replaced sensor from its current tag back to previous calibration and work orders, checking range and zero comparability. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 設備ID重用但未保留更換日期，會把新感測器的偏移解讀成隧道結構突然改變。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~Reusing an asset ID without replacement dates can turn a new-sensor offset into a false sudden structural change. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查更換過的感測器，從現行標籤追到舊型號校正與工單，驗證量程和零點是否可比。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Channel Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Sample a replaced sensor from its current tag back to previous calibration and work orders, checking range and zero comparability. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「環向受力與接縫柔度」，再獨立計算「列車壓力波與動壓量級」。原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.32 MPa；半徑=3.1 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=2.83429 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為3.11771 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=41 m/s。q=ρv²/2=1008.6 Pa。僅把列車速度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1220.41 Pa。邊界：不可壓動壓尺度，不是可壓縮列車壓力波解；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate ring force and joint flexibility, then independently calculate train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale. Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.32 MPa; radius=3.1 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=2.83429 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 3.11771 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=41 m/s. q=ρv²/2=1008.6 Pa. Increasing only train speed by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1220.41 Pa. Boundary: Incompressible dynamic-pressure scale, not a compressible train pressure-wave solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 1994 年公開記錄：英法海底隧道開放，建立海峽兩岸固定鐵路連結。英法海底隧道讓客貨列車與車輛接駁列車通過英吉利海峽，營運商列長約50公里並記錄1994年啟用。本進階課把海底水壓、襯砌接縫、熱量、氣動擾動與維修可用率連成同一系統，特別比較主孔與服務通道的任務差異，避免把各設備單獨合格當整體服務可靠。本課把「主孔服務孔介面、壓力波與長期可維護性」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 1994: The Channel Tunnel opens as a fixed railway connection across the Channel. The approximately 50 km Channel Tunnel carries passenger, freight and vehicle-shuttle trains beneath the English Channel and opened in 1994. This advanced course links subsea pressure, lining joints, heat, aerodynamic disturbances and maintenance availability. It distinguishes the duties of running bores and service access, showing why individual equipment compliance does not by itself establish a reliable operating system. The course treats running-bore and service-gallery interfaces, pressure waves and maintainability as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 50 km，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 50 km; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
1994 年事件：英法海底隧道開放，建立海峽兩岸固定鐵路連結。~1994 event: The Channel Tunnel opens as a fixed railway connection across the Channel.

教學「測壓水頭」：水密度=1000 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=333.54 kPa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching piezometric head: water density=1000 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 333.54 kPa; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「襯砌環向壓縮」：均勻外壓=0.32 MPa，其餘輸入依單元，結果=2.83429 MPa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching lining hoop compression: uniform external pressure=0.32 MPa, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 2.83429 MPa; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「通風顯熱量」：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=1186.7 kW；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching ventilation sensible heat: air density=1.2 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 1186.7 kW; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「入口壓力擾動」：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=1008.6 Pa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching portal pressure disturbance: air density=1.2 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 1008.6 Pa; not measured or accepted project data.
